name: Scott Franklin
stance: Backs a targeted, size-tiered federal framework of guardrails for the handful of companies building the most powerful frontier AI models.

statements.text: Welcomed the rescission of the Biden-era AI chip export rule, which he had urged alongside Rep. McCormick, framing it as protecting national security and keeping China in check.
As AI evolves, so do the threats. @RepPfluger's Generative AI Terrorism Risk Assessment Act takes a practical step toward understanding how terrorists may try to exploit this technology.
This proposal builds on the bipartisan House AI Task Force's work and takes a needed step toward establishing clear rules of the road for advanced AI systems while encouraging innovation.
Original cosponsor of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, a targeted federal framework of transparency, independent evaluation and incident reporting for the most advanced AI systems.
focusing only on the handful of companies developing the most powerful frontier AI models
As a cosponsor of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, I'm working with @JayObernolte to ensure our regulatory framework keeps pace with sophisticated frontier AI models while fostering American innovation.
One of ten signers of the bipartisan leadership letter urging Congress to act on AI oversight, security and transparency.
Cutting edge Frontier AI models are now showing the ability to do things their creators didn’t intend or anticipate.
